== Description ==
'''D-60i''' is an [[Entities|entity]] made of 2 different faces that constantly change appearances, it also takes the form of the numbers "3", "2", and "1" when it first spawns in.

== Behavior ==
When '''D-60i''' spawns in, a large countdown starting at 3 will appear in the middle of the room.

When this countdown is complete, '''D-60i''' will charge up, getting ready for its attack.

After 6 seconds of charging, '''D-60i''' will become lethal, and move to the latest room.

Once '''D-60i''' has completed its movement to the latest room, it's rebounding-cycle will begin.

'''D-60i''', in it's "Fall-back" phase, will get slightly faster per every room it passes, capping at a speed of 800 studs/s.

'''D-60i''' will proceed to move backwards until it has reached 50 rooms behind the main room, at which point it will make a loud bang sound as it rushes to the main room, making heavy static as it approaches. Once '''D-60i''' touches the door, it will smash it down (regardless of if it's a Derelict Lab door or a Cave door).

'''D-60i''' will then repeat this process after a short delay of 0.5 to 1.5 seconds, unless he is in the [[Red Rooms]], where he won't stall at all.

Okay, so what makes '''D-60i''' difficult then? His '''Phase 2.'''

After 60 rooms have passed since the countdown was seen, the '''D-60i''' OST (Trepidation) will begin to play. At which point everytime it smashes a door, there will be a 1 in 7 chance for '''D-60i''' to enter phase 2.


When '''D-60i''' enters phase 2, it will move to the center of the room, before over-charging. It's still lethal while over-charging, so don't leave your hiding place. The music will fade out when he's moved to the center of the room.

When 6 seconds have passed, '''D-60i''' will very swiftly dissapear, with an edited version of [[D-60]]'s old despawn sound playing shortly after.

While '''D-60i''' is gone, it will delay it's phase 2 start until either:

# 15 seconds have passed
# the door has been opened by a player or an entity.

After either of the requirements are met, '''D-60i''' will break the door of the main room down, and play [[D-140]]'s spawn sound while in the center of the next room. '''D-60i''' will wait there for ~5 seconds, before it makes a loud explosion and moves backwards at lightspeed (800 studs/s), breaking every locker/cabinet in the next room in the process.

The second part of Trepidation will now play;

From then on, '''D-60i''' will break completely random lockers in the room it breaks into every time it smashes a door.

After '''D-60i''' has existed for 30 rooms, there will be a 1 in 15 that '''D-60i''' despawns.

When '''D-60i''' despawns, it will make constant loud explosion sounds, and then make one, longer explosion with many large particle effects coming out of it.

'''D-60i''' has dissapeared, and you will be awarded the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/3050908394432290/Invasion-Evasion|Invasion Invasion Evasion badge].

== Strategy & Tips ==

* Use entities like [[D-5]] and [[D-55]] as [[Claustrophobia]] deniers, as they can be very helpful in hard entity comboes.
* Since '''D-60i''' can spawn entities, you should be careful of [[D-5]] surprise attacks after leaving your hiding place, a good way to check this is waiting inside of your hiding place until you see [[Claustrophobia]]'s message, or roughly ~10 seconds have passed.

* [https://youtu.be/It4dFf4mmTQ?si=tRC6jRYLOlszR4BS Video Representation]

== Trivia ==

* <s>'''D-60i''' cannot locker-snipe, use this to your advantage to avoid unnecessary [[Claustrophobia]] damage!</s>
* ↑ This is no longer true, as '''D-60i''' can locker-snipe you in Phase 2b. Dealing around 10% damage of your health. 
* '''D-60i''' can only spawn once in your run.
* '''D-60i''' can spawn entities when smashing doors.
* '''D-60i''' is the 3rd most time consuming entity/challenge in the game (second being [[D-60ii]], first being the [[Shadow Challenge|shadow challenge]] (not including [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse|A&SP]])
* '''D-60i's''' Phase 2 is has somewhat like wise similarites to [https://r-interminable-rooms.fandom.com/wiki/A-60/X-60 X-60] from Interminable Rooms Recoded
* '''D-60i''' has a 1 in 1000 to spawn every door past D-220, as long as [[D-60]] isn't currently active.
* '''D-60i''' is forced to spawn at door D-750 if player starts at door D-0, but '''D-60i''' won’t despawn until some point in [[Red Rooms]] is reached. (If he reaches [[Red Rooms]] but isnt in Phase 2 (b), he won't despawn until he actually goes phase 2 (b).
* Old Trepidation OST (Old Bossfight theme)
** https://youtu.be/xhUaF0Ya1tE?si=zf6Rf-AJh2xwbd_s
* '''D-60i'''<nowiki/>'s (old) phase 1 music is a loop of his (old) OST from: 0:00 to 1:24 minutes (though after it plays the first time, it loops back to 0:12 seconds in).
* '''D-60i'''<nowiki/>'s (old) phase 2(a) music is a loop of his (old) OST from: 1:28 to 2:48 minutes (though after it plays the first time, it loops back to 1:48 minutes in).
* '''D-60i'''<nowiki/>'s (old) phase 2(b) (plays when his 1 in 15 to despawn per rebound starts) music is a loop of his (old) OST from: 2:36 to 3:24 minutes (though after it plays for the first time, it loops back to 3:00 minutes in).
* Once '''D-60i''' is about to despawn, a subtitle appears, with the text "<span style="color: orange;>kaput</span>" for a split second.
